answer: Mechanism: canyon-depth toll. Each new agent identity pays a sable fee—an irrevocable, per-identity gas burn at creation—sized to the canyon depth already carved by that attacker's prior clones, so each marginal clone costs strictly more than the last. A hard revenue ridge caps what any attacker can extract; past the ridge, every additional clone is negative-EV because the climbing toll outpaces any plausible earnings.
